QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is off by default (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` is off by default (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:2196`). Every mutex call site is gated on `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the macros controlling the threading code, and says the mutex call sites are gated on MBEDTLS_THREADING_C.
